Create a command homeElevator() that drives the motor downward at a speed of -0.2 until the bottom limit switch returns true, then stops the motor and resets the TalonFX's internal encoder position to 0 using setPosition(). Use the until() decorator and andThen() to chain the finishing steps.

solutionCode.python:
from phoenix6.hardware import TalonFX
from wpilib2 import DigitalInput
from wpilib2.command import SubsystemBase
class ElevatorSubsystem(SubsystemBase):
	elevator_motor = TalonFX(5)
	bottom_limit_switch = DigitalInput(1)
	def home_elevator(self):
		def finish():
			self.elevator_motor.stop_motor()
			self.elevator_motor.set_position(0)
		return self.run(lambda: self.elevator_motor.set(-0.2)) \
			.until(lambda: self.bottom_limit_switch.get()) \
			.andThen(lambda: finish())
